project.name: osgi/domains/crypto
project.description: The crypto seam-realisations — the cross-cutting modules that seal / convert key material for whoever needs it, grouped because none belongs to a single consumer domain: sops-process (the ONE sops runner, dual-realm, driven by sops-edge and by the host's SopsAtRest) and sops-edge (shells sops through it, seals a YAML for age recipients — the node's sops-nix envelope). Each fills a seam owned lower (SopsEncryptor, SopsDecryptor); this group only aggregates them so the layout mirrors the concern.
